integrity: Self-contained analytic proof supplies all quantified conclusions. A standalone Python standard-library checker provides 336 exact arithmetic tests and 95 sample numerical diagnostics, which are not substituted for infinite-dimensional quantifier proofs. scientific_limitations: Exact for the stated triangular linear slow-fast flow, positive slow-coordinate Euclidean fast-norm returns, epsilon>0, kappa>=0 and initial (u,v)=(0,delta), delta!=0. No claim for arbitrary fast directions, norms, nonlinear perturbations, arbitrary nilpotent fields, or full-state periodicity.
title: A sharp three-return fold from zero-mean Jordan shear in slow-fast passage
